title: The first 150 Spaces to pay a Founding Year hold numbered Founder seats, the offer closes at 150, and /offer shows how many are taken

source.ref: Launch milestones doc rulings 2026-11-23 (project thread: Build the Founding Year checkout; owner picked 'Start a thread now' 2026-11-25 00:09Z)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-25: Founder seats do not exist. No count, number, cap or display anywhere. Owner ruling 2026-11-23: the Founder cap stays 150, numbered and visible; the milestones doc counts a Founder as a Space that paid its Founding Year in cash or by card (comped Spaces do not count). Fix: number the seats in payment order from founding_members.meta.founding_year (no new table), refuse the Founding Year once 150 are taken, and show the count on /offer.

DONE 2026-11-25: FOUNDING_YEAR.seatCap = 150 in lib/billing/founding-year.ts. A seat is a Space's place in payment order among founding_members rows carrying meta.founding_year (numberFounderSeats, pure; a lapsed row keeps its number), read by lib/billing/founder-seats.ts (founderSeatsTaken, founderSeatFor; unreadable = null). createSpaceLoadoutCheckout stops selling the Founding Year once 150 are taken (yearly becomes the ordinary yearly price); the pricing box drops the $441 / $990 yearly price at the same moment; /offer shows 'Founder seats taken: N of 150' and the Space's own number. No migration. Tests: founding-year.test.ts, space-plan-checkout.test.ts, member-pricing-box.test.tsx.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
